text_block_list.text:
Woiya happy! Haiya lucky! Thank you,
Shiraoki!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Woiya happyyy! ☆ Haiya luckyyy! ☆
Thank you,
Shiraokiii! ☆

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, this Japanese spell is very difficult!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
By the way, what do these words mean
anyway?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Meaning?! Well, let me rephrase it a
bit...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes to happy clappies! No more worries,
go! All
praise to the great Shiraoki!
Thank you!
